Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after revelations on extramarital affairs

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after revelations on extramarital affairs ===

[Source 1 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261112-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-after-revelations-on-extramarital-affairs):
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after revelations on extramarital affairs

Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of AI giant Nvidia on Thursday, November 12, after revelations he had two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Washington Fraser Jackson and FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert have more.

[Source 2 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/technology/live/2026/nov/12/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-affairs-share-price-plunges-live-latest):
Nvidia turmoil continues as Jensen Huang resigns over affairs scandal and company appoints interim CEO – as it happened

This live blog is now closed.Analysis: Jensen Huang built an AI kingdom. What now?Full report: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEOToo big – and too well-connected – to sack? Huang does not enjoy the supercharged voting rights that are par for the course elsewhere – his shareholding is a plain vanilla 3.6%. On the other hand, Nvidia’s board does not appear to have spent much time worrying about succession planning and “key person risk” or other standard concerns of corporate governance wonks outside the US.
